title: Fall Raku Workshop & Firing
commitment: Build Day: Sat Sept 19, 1-3pm; Glaze Day: Fri Oct 9, 6-8pm; Firing Day: Sat Oct 10, 10am until complete. Rain date: Sat Oct 17, 1pm.
cost_text: $150 per student (includes 5 lbs clay, glaze, and firing). Current studio members/students can purchase 5 lbs raku clay for $35 to use in their studio time and participate in firing Oct 10.
pay_text: $150 per non-student; $35 clay option for current members/students
how_to_join: Register through signup link; choose Current Student or Non-Student status
summary: Three-day raku workshop and firing with build, glaze, and firing days in September-October 2026. Create up to two pieces per person. No prior experience needed. Open to public; current studio members can bring their own pre-formed pieces.
source_quote:
Raku Workshop & Firing
This workshop consists of one building day, one glaze day and one Raku firing experience. You will be able to create and complete two items per person. No experience required.
evidence_sentence: The Raku Workshop & Firing page describes a three-part workshop culminating in a raku firing on October 10, 2026, open to all with no prior experience required.
evidence_quote: This workshop consists of one building day, one glaze day and one Raku firing experience.
